description: Author the IaC (never deployed) and write the documentation. This is plan.md items 12-13 and design.md sections 11, 12.1, 12.2 and Appendix A, with [F34] in ADR Â§7. IaC: the UrbaniApp table (PK/SK, GSI1 projection ALL, PAY_PER_REQUEST, shared CMK, PITR, RETAIN) and grantAppDataAccess in infra/lib/persistence-construct.ts; UrbaniDashboardTaskRole (ecs-tasks principal with an aws:SourceAccount condition) in security-construct.ts; the task role wired in dashboard-construct.ts with DB_DRIVER staying sqlite; the stack wiring plus an AppTableName output; infra/test/app-table.check.ts, an offline in-process template assertion run by `npm run check` (no CDK CLI). The IaC is independent of the backend code; the docs describe the FEAT-004 commands, so this feature runs last.

Keep DB_DRIVER: 'sqlite' and add the comment 'DPI 2 item 14: set DB_DRIVER=dynamodb, DYNAMODB_TABLE_PREFIX, remove the /data volume, raise desiredCount >= 2.' Update the persistence NOTE comment to point at the UrbaniApp table. infra/lib/urbani-dpi-stack.ts: after PersistenceConstruct call persistence.grantAppDataAccess(security.dashboardTaskRole), pass security.dashboardTaskRole to new DashboardConstruct(...), and add new CfnOutput(this, 'AppTableName', { value: persistence.appTable.tableName }).

infra/package.json: add script "check": "ts-node test/app-table.check.ts". infra/tsconfig.json: add "test/**/*.ts" to include. Create infra/test/app-table.check.ts asserting the six Â§11 checks with Template/Match from aws-cdk-lib/assertions and node:assert/strict, on new UrbaniDpiStack(new App(), 'UrbaniDpiCheck') with no env. Locate resources by TableName 'UrbaniApp'/'UrbaniAlerts' and RoleName 'UrbaniDashboardTaskRole'; compare the action lists sorted; match the ViaService token shape (Fn::Join with AWS::Region); assert nothing references UrbaniAlerts and no dynamodb:Scan, DescribeTable or dynamodb:*; the backend container env keeps DB_DRIVER 'sqlite'. Print a one-line pass summary and exit non-zero on failure. Only if Template.fromStack demands a concrete env, use the Â§15.7 dummy env (account 111111111111, region us-east-1). Do not touch deploy-ecs.sh or redeploy.sh. Never run the CDK CLI.

Create docs/adr/0001-dynamodb-persistence.md following the 14-part outline in design Â§12.1. Include: status 'Accepted (DPI 2 item 1); deployment pending client AWS account'; the Â§5.2 key-schema table; the Â§5.3 access-pattern table (patterns 1-47, pattern 7 marked 'not implemented in item 1; item 2 adds users.list()'); the correctness mechanisms (Â§5.4, Â§5.5); the accepted divergences of Â§2.5 plus 'empty ids' [F34] with the live-sync consequence; the consistency caveats (Â§5.6); pagination and scale thresholds (about 1,000 alerts or 3 MB per entity partition; Â§5.7 table); the item size and key policy (Â§5.8); the relationship to UrbaniAlerts (Â§5.9); security; alternatives; and consequences, including the item 2 follow-up that create-user must require an explicit role.
